messages.subject: S3 review: PASS
messages.body: Reviewed S3 at 04a9e8f3c4fb9acdea6e0279b5719c37bdfcd43a: AC-7 and AC-9 both pass; the full suite is 78 tests OK and probes (error first/last/middle, --check stale+error, --stdout with an erroring file, duplicate file, directory arg) behaved correctly with exit aggregation 2>1>0. README Usage matches the real CLI and exit codes, and I saw no S1/S2 regression. Remaining are low items only: an overlong except line at cli.py:75, and unguarded tests for directory, duplicate file, and --stdout with the error last or in the middle.
